protocol.analysis: Within each difficulty/weapon stratum, independent paired seed blocks. Wilson 95% win intervals, approximate Student t mean/paired score intervals; paired wins show discordance and point differences with interval unavailable. Constant samples do not imply zero uncertainty. No weapon pooling, multiple-comparison adjustment or human-difficulty claim. Errors/timeouts remain attempts. No tuning on evaluation.
